title: The empirical risk, averaged
statement_md:
`empirical_risk` is the supervised objective: the **average** squared error over the dataset.

The starter returns the total squared error instead of the mean. Fix it without changing the signature.

- `sum((pred - target) ** 2) / n`
- raise `ValueError` when the lengths differ
- return a `float`
mutations: return float(sum((p - y) ** 2 for p, y in zip(a[0], a[1])))
return float(sum(abs(p - y) for p, y in zip(a[0], a[1])) / len(a[0]))
